>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/packages/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Read-only view of a single Package, in exactly the shape `POST /tasks/{id}/package-seals` returns on 201. This is how the SLAM operator and the outbound dock loader learn the SLAM outcome: `POST /packages/{id}/slam-runs` answers `204` both when a label was applied and when the package was diverted, so read `status` here — `LABELED` means the carton goes to the truck by its `sortLane`, `DIVERTED` means it goes to problem-solve. Side-effect-free (see [ADR-0033](https://iqvo.github.io/fulfillment-execution/docs/adr/0033-package-read-model)).
